source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Αγία Σοφία η θαυματουργή»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. **The whole of the page's text is one sentence: «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο της Αγίας.»** That is a refusal to tell the life and not a refusal to vouch for her: no asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου…». No year, no place, no relic, no hymn. `types` carries only `wonderworker`, which is what the calendar line's by-name «η θαυματουργή» says, and the epigram repeats — «Θεού σοφίαν ηγάπησε Σοφία, Όθεν χάριν δέδεκτο και των θαυμάτων». **The display name is the day and not the by-name, because `lib/honorific.js` composes the rank from `types`.** The corpus keeps six other folders of this name, among them a `sophia-the-physician` on the Romanian 22 mai and a `sophia-martyr-18-september`; none of them is this woman and the page offers nothing that would join them.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (2 October 2026).
